notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Newly added Diary in the menu, where it is possible to recall important information about the game. More content in Diary will come soon, so stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42303518/00053cc29935733ac7dc9b6a210fbf16a9176d0d.png[/img]

Bring the light into the world of Ifeon!

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
It is just the little things that I found.
[list]
[*] Improve UI for unspent Light Seals point, to make it more visible. 
[*] Fix exceptional stuck when jumping into the abyss spike.
[*] Fix visual bug for gaining additional Light Seals (100 Abyss Source = +1 Light Seal).
[/list]
